description:
RESPONSIBILITIES:  •Translate application storyboards and use cases into functional applications  •Design, build, and maintain efficient, reusable, and reliable C#, VB.NET, and T-SQL code  •Ensure the best possible performance, quality, and responsiveness of applications  •Identify bottlenecks and bugs, and devise solutions to these problems  •Help maintain code quality, organization, and automatization  QUALIFICATIONS:  •Proficiency in C# and VB.NET, with a good knowledge of its ecosystems  •Familiarity with the .NET framework and all of its versions starting with 2.0  •Proficiency in Microsoft SQL Server and all of its versions starting with Microsoft SQL 2000  •Familiarity with caching mechanisms such as .NET cache, NCache, memcached, and Amazon Elasticache  •Familiarity with NoSQL solutions such as mongoDB and Redis  •Experience in developing and maintaining online e-commerce systems that are both shopping cart and subscription based.  •Experience in developing and maintaining streaming and download-based audio and video services.  •Experience in developing and maintaining http-based API frameworks  •Experience in developing and maintaining mobile and desktop browser-based applications  •Strong understanding of object-oriented programming  •Skill for writing reusable C# and VB.NET libraries  •Familiarity with various design and architectural patterns  •Knack for writing clean, readable C#, VB.NET, and T-SQL code  •Understanding fundamental design principles behind a scalable application  •Creating database schemas that represent and support business processes  •Implementing automated testing platforms and unit tests  •Proficient understanding of code versioning tools such as Git and SVN  •Excellent written and verbal English skills  •Familiarity with AWS hosting, storage, and delivery services such as S3, EC2, CloudFront, and Glacier  •BS or MS in Computer Science or equivalent experience 


 C#,VB.NET,.NET framework,mongoDB,NoSQL
